title: Fixed trace collapse behavior and contrast
points: Failure case: some trace controls could open but not reliably collapse again, and light-mode stage accents were too faint to distinguish from nested dropdowns.
Flow logic fixed: trace stages now toggle closed when clicked again, and expandable detail blocks keep their own open state instead of being pinned open by a fixed prop.
Shipped result: users can collapse stages and subdetails predictably, with stronger primary accents for stages and brighter blue accents for nested dropdowns.
